content: @tanstack/react-virtual v3.14.3 (published ~7 days ago from Jun 2026). React 19 compatible — set useFlushSync: false to suppress flushSync lifecycle warning in React 19. Has dedicated chat message list example (reverse-scroll, pinned-to-bottom). Headless virtualization, no CSS opinion. 1321 dependents on npm. Actively maintained by TanStack team.
